description: Write acceptance tests for the cameras module in test/acceptance/cameras.test.js from .hub/spec.md and the interface JSDoc only (do not read or rely on implementation details). Cover documented behavior, exact strings, error classes and codes, and edge cases. No network: inject fake fetch, sources and routers. Tests may fail until the module is built.
summary: 58 acceptance tests in test/acceptance/cameras.test.js (plus 7 JSON fixtures in test/fixtures/cameras/) covering buildOverpassQuery, parseOverpass, OverpassCameraSource tile cache/TTL/User-Agent/UpstreamError, the sample-file schema, loadSampleCameras and FixtureCameraSource, using a fake fetch and clock (no network). Against the current stubs 5 pass and 53 fail, as expected until the cameras module is built. A throwaway reference implementation written from the spec passed all 58 in two query/request styles, and seeded bugs failed the matching tests. Interpretations logged as cameras-tests.1-3.
title: Acceptance tests for camera sources
